listing.eventDescription: One Mercari US listing delivered as a row: title, price in dollars, original price and discount, status, condition, brand, size, colour, category, photos and the search it came from. Every listing is billed once per run. With a monitor, a listing is billed when it is new to that monitor; with monitorChanges also when its price or status changed, with monitorDeliverUnchanged also when it is delivered again unchanged, and with checkRemovedListings for each sold, changed or removed listing its re-checks deliver. Listings left out by your filters, listings already delivered, searches Mercari did not apply as sent and listing links that no longer exist are free status rows or counters.

listing-details.eventDescription: A delivered listing's detail, read and added to its row: description (as the seller wrote it), likes, shipping payer, fee, class, ships from state and delivery estimate, Buyer Protection fee and total, offers, people with it in their cart, Mercari Authenticate, the moment of the sale and days to sell, and the seller's rating with its count, sales count and number of listings. The seller's public id, display name and profile link come only with includePersonalData on. Charged only when the detail was read and the listing delivered.

results-page.eventDescription: One search results page read by a monitor run (a run with a monitor name), whatever it held. Runs without a monitor never pay it.

price-summary.eventDescription: One summary row per search (priceSummary): the count, lowest, highest, average and median price, the quartiles, the share sold, the median days to sell of the listings whose detail was read and, with targetMarginPercent, a suggested highest buy price. Charged only when the row holds at least one price.

listing-check.eventDescription: A change monitor's re-read of a listing it delivered before and its searches did not show this run (checkRemovedListings), to learn whether it sold, changed its price or was removed. Charged only when Mercari answered the read; a listing found sold, changed or removed is also delivered as a row and billed as a Listing.
